# telnyx_auto_recharge_preferences (Resource)

The account's automatic balance top-up: when the balance falls below a threshold, Telnyx charges the recharge amount. There is one per account; destroy removes it from Terraform state only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Top the balance up by 100 whenever it falls below 20. There is one per
# account.
resource "telnyx_auto_recharge_preferences" "this" {
  enabled          = true
  threshold_amount = "20.00"
  recharge_amount  = "100.00"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether auto recharge is enabled.
- `invoice_enabled` (Boolean)
- `preference` (String) The payment preference for auto recharge. One of `ach`, `credit_paypal`.
- `recharge_amount` (String) The amount to recharge the account, the actual recharge amount will be the amount necessary to reach the threshold amount plus the recharge amount.
- `threshold_amount` (String) The threshold amount at which the account will be recharged.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always auto_recharge_preferences: there is one per account.
- `record_type` (String) The record type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_auto_recharge_preferences.example auto_recharge_preferences
```
